svg.text: MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Prototype P01: FDM ASA, 0.2 layer, 4 perimeters, 30% gyroid; production: moulded PC/ABS, draft 1°.
2. Wall 2.5, top deck 3.0, internal ribs 1.8 at 30 pitch under the deck. Fillets R1 unless noted.
3. Bottom cover (not shown): 2.0 PC/ABS, 6 × M3 self-tapping, IP54 gasket 1.5 EPDM cord.
4. P02 sits on the deck inside the ring; mica 0.5 bonded underneath (high-temp silicone).
Al 5052-H32 t 1.5 + mica 0.5; holes match P01 deck
